messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: New RStudio discussion site
parts:
Hi all,

I wanted to let you all know about <http://community.rstudio.com> - a
new discussion forum for ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr and generally all
things tidyverse (as well as shiny and RStudio IDE). One of the goals
of the site is to provide a central home for all tidyverse
discussions, rather than scattering them over multiple mailing lists.
(And to also provide an environment that's a bit more modern and
pleasant to use than google groups).

Please consider asking your questions there in the future, and if
you're a long time mailing list contributor, please consider answering
questions there too. We have a bunch of prizes to help get the ball
rolling - read the full announcement at
<https://blog.rstudio.com/2017/09/14/rstudio-community/> for details.

Hadley

--
http://hadley.nz

> did you consider some mail gateway?
>
> the mailing lists just nicely and conveniently come together with all
> the other ones in one old fashioned yet well functioning place :-)

There seems to be a "Mailing list mode" under the Email settings in your
profile. Within that it looks like you can restrict it by category or
tag, eg I might limit it to the tidyverse category not being an RStudio
user or even the ggplot tag since I'm not (yet) using the full
tidyverse.

I think I'm going to give that a try for a bit.

Ron.
